xna-type.name: LeaderboardWriter
xna-type.summary: Records leaderboard data for players in a NetworkSession.
xna-type.remarks: Warning This class and all related methods and properties only retrieve a calculated result for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, the properties in this class will not return a calculated result, and related methods will report a NotSupportedException .

method.name: GetLeaderboard
method.summary: Gets a leaderboard entry that can be used to write to a specified leaderboard.

overload.summary: Gets a leaderboard entry that can be used to write to a specified leaderboard.

parameters.parameter: The identity of the leaderboard to write to.

overload.returns: A LeaderboardEntry that can be used for writing to the leaderboard.
